# Value Slider

The Value Slider fieldtype allows the user to select a numerical value.

:::note
The following examples use a field named `value_slider_field`. This should be replaced with your field name.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.value_slider_field }}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->value_slider_field }}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Parameters

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.value_slider_field.parameters({decimal_place: '2', prefix: 'yes', suffix: 'yes'}) }}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->value_slider_field->parameters(['decimal_place' => '2', 'prefix' => 'yes', 'suffix' => 'yes']) }}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

:::info
See the ExpressionEngine Documentation for more information on the [Value Slider fieldtype](https://docs.expressionengine.com/latest/fieldtypes/value-slider.html)
:::
